text: The paper reports that persona-based GPT-4o judges achieve the highest debate accuracy when debaters know the judge's persona (78.5%), followed by private-persona judges (77.3%), both above human judges (70.1%, p < 0.01); default judges without personas are comparable to humans, with GPT-4o at 69.8% and Qwen2.5-7B at 70.7% in debate (not significant, p = 0.88).
title: Persona-conditioned GPT-4o judges of debate reach 78.5% vs 70.1% for human judges
